override.reason: t4's first acceptanceCheck, lifted near-verbatim from the LLD's own testStrategy.invariantsToPreserve, described an end-to-end property ("written for every ... run") this Story's own non-goals explicitly place out of scope (no sandbox/mutation checkpoint exists or is built here -- confirmed via the LLD's own capability-discovery grounding and its 'extension points only' framing). Reworded to the scope-honest, directly-provable claim: the persistence function's write is unconditional by construction (no SecurityFinding parameter, never gated on one). No other content changed. Caught by the build gate rejecting t4 twice on this exact ground; corrected rather than re-litigated against code that cannot exist within this Story.

summary.prose: Building this Story means adding four small, independent extension-point types to the review framework -- SecurityFinding, SecurityLocator, an EvidenceProvider registry stub, and a VerificationReceipt record -- plus the per-(type,model) JSON Schema transformers the inheritance-heavy shapes need for structured-output safety. Every piece is additive: SecurityFinding and SecurityLocator are plain interfaces extending the now-built sibling Finding/Locator types, VerificationReceipt is a new sibling module mirroring the existing TEST RECORD's TESTS.md-beside-BUILD.md pattern for its own RECEIPTS.md, and EvidenceProvider is a standalone registry shape with no real provider wiring yet. Five small-to-medium Tasks, no changes to any existing exported type, field, or function signature.

tasks.title: Add SecurityFinding interface, isSecurityFinding type guard, risk-family verdict representation, and policy-override staleness check
tasks.summary: Add `SecurityFinding` as a plain TS interface extending the base `Finding` (src/workflow/review-round/finding.ts) with kind:'security', checkId, violatedPolicyRef, evidence, fixability, confidence, enforcementMode, the revision-anchored override fields overriddenBy/overrideReason/overriddenAt, and receiptId (an optional string id of a corroborating VerificationReceipt -- never the receipt object itself). Add an `isSecurityFinding` type guard checking the `kind` discriminant. Add a risk-family verdict representation modeled as an informational, zero-severity SecurityFinding for applicable/not-applicable/uncertain families. Add the policy-override staleness check comparing overriddenAt against the Scope's current revision.
acceptanceChecks: SecurityFinding structurally extends base Finding -- every Finding field present plus the security-only fields including receiptId
isSecurityFinding returns true only for an object whose kind discriminant is exactly 'security'
A risk-family verdict (applicable/not-applicable/uncertain + reason), including not-applicable ones, is representable as an informational, zero-severity SecurityFinding
A stale override (overriddenAt diverges from the Scope's current revision) is rejected by the staleness check
The framework's shared reconciliation pass accepts a mixed Finding/SecurityFinding list with zero change to its own logic
The docgen 'review-report' renderer renders a round containing SecurityFinding entries with zero change to its own type signature

tasks.title: Add SecurityLocator interface extending Locator
tasks.summary: Add `SecurityLocator` as a plain TS interface extending the framework's `Locator` (src/workflow/artifact-core/types.ts:271-274) with trustBoundaryId and taintPathStepIndex as first-class optional fields, following the open-Locator-kind extensibility pattern. No change to Locator or Pointer themselves -- a security-graph citation is represented as Pointer{path, section: SecurityLocator, contentHash?}, reusing Pointer unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: SecurityLocator structurally extends Locator -- kind and value fields present plus trustBoundaryId and taintPathStepIndex
A SecurityLocator instance is assignable to Pointer.section with no change to Pointer's own type

tests.name: SecurityLocator structural extension of Locator/Pointer (trust-boundary id + taint-path step index fields)

tasks.title: Add EvidenceProvider interface/registry and SecurityEvidence shape
tasks.summary: Add the `EvidenceProvider` interface/registry stub for the five deterministic evidence-provider categories (secret scanning, SAST, dependency/SBOM, IaC/container, language-native checks), distinct from the general tool registry, with a common input/output contract. Add `SecurityEvidence` (providerCategory + an optional SecurityLocator) feeding SecurityFinding.evidence uniformly. Extension-point only: no real daemon-IPC wiring or provider implementations in this Story.
acceptanceChecks: EvidenceProvider interface defines a common input/output contract shared by all five provider categories
SecurityEvidence carries providerCategory and an optional SecurityLocator-typed locator field

tasks.title: Add VerificationReceipt type and a parallel RECEIPTS.md record module
tasks.summary: Add `VerificationReceipt` (result, environment, pass/fail outcome) and a new sibling module to src/workflow/runners/build/test-record.ts (e.g. receipt-record.ts) mirroring TestRecordCase/TestRecordReported/persistTestRecordTask/readTestRecord/renderTestRecordMd, reusing the existing writeArtifact/writeAtomic (src/workflow/storage.ts) and storeRound/withStoredModel (src/workflow/runners/build/round-writer.ts) primitives unchanged. Renders RECEIPTS.md beside the review artifact exactly as TESTS.md sits beside BUILD.md: a non-approvable RECORD, written for every sandbox/mutation checkpoint run (pass or fail), referenced by id from a corroborating SecurityFinding.
acceptanceChecks: persistVerificationReceipt's write is unconditional for whatever outcome (pass or fail) it is given -- it takes no SecurityFinding parameter anywhere and is never gated on one, proven directly against the real function; wiring an actual sandbox/mutation checkpoint to call it is this Story's own non-goal (LLD summary: "no ... evidence-provider internals ... are designed here"), tracked separately, not built or testable within this Story's scope
RECEIPTS.md renders beside the review artifact using the existing writeArtifact/writeAtomic/storeRound/withStoredModel machinery, unmodified
An approval attempt against a RECEIPTS.md/VerificationReceipt record is refused, matching TESTS.md's own non-approvable-record behavior

tasks.title: Add per-(type,model) JSON Schema transformers for SecurityFinding and SecurityLocator
tasks.summary: Add bidirectional JSON Schema transformers (canonical model -> a shape a given (type, target model) pair reliably emits against, and back) for SecurityFinding and SecurityLocator, extending the pattern already used for the codex provider, so the union/inheritance-heavy shapes added by t1/t2 are safely presentable to structured-output LLM calls.
